canonical_project: Lindley Moor Data Centre Campus proposal

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Kirklees planning history records 2009/92550 outline data campus refused, followed by 2011/91518 outline application for a Data Centre Campus with access off Lindley Moor Road approved subject to Section 106. Later planning documents suggest the site was involved in subsequent mixed industrial/residential proposals; build-out status unclear.
